_comment: Latest news per peer for the Peers page and the Overview. scripts/collect_peernews.py runs one Google News search per entry (free RSS, no key). 'q' uses Google News search syntax: quotes for exact names, OR, -word to exclude. 'lang' = en or de. Up to 'maxPerCompany' newest headlines from the last 'days' days are kept.

wepa.q: "WEPA" (Hygieneprodukte OR Hygienepapier OR Toilettenpapier OR Tissue OR Papierfabrik)
"WEPA" (tissue OR hygiene paper OR paper mill) -printing -print
